editorial.hook: French café in Miami Lakes with muffins and cookies baked fresh daily
editorial.why_here: Vanilla Espresso French Café welcomes guests in Miami Lakes and Miramar for coffee, breakfast or lunch in a relaxed, friendly space. It says its fresh espresso drinks and café meals are made daily with quality ingredients, and its muffins, cookies and seasonal sweets are baked fresh daily.

editorial.why_here: Mac's Club Deuce calls itself Miami's oldest bar and dates to 1926. The homepage describes a laid-back ambiance with rustic decor, a pool table and a jukebox, making it a local hangout.

editorial.hook: St. Augustine tropical lounge dedicated to live entertainment in North Florida
editorial.why_here: The Tradewinds Tropical Lounge says it is dedicated to having the very best live entertainment in North Florida. Its music evolved from its early days as a folk lounge to a current mix of rock'n'roll, blues, and a little country, under the line Always Better Live.
editorial.know_before: Check the Live Music Schedule on the official site before you go, since live entertainment is the focus of the Tradewinds Tropical Lounge.
